      paper: "#FFFFFF"
      ink: "#22282E"
      ink-soft: "#5C666F"

      blue: "#0F4C81"
    background: paper
    foreground: ink
    primary: blue

  # No font is named beyond the one above, so nothing is fetched from a font
  # service; a system without it falls back to the default of the renderer.
  typography:
    headings:
      weight: bold
      color: red
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: false
    message: false

    dev.args: {bg: "white"}

    fig-width: 6.8
    fig-height: 2.5

  error: true
---

```{r setup}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What to set for a report
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The path to the config file, whose esef section names the Silver layer of
# the module. A chunk runs with the directory of this template as its working
# directory, which is inside the installed package, so the path is taken from
# the environment variable FINCOMMONS_CONFIG where it is set and is otherwise
# a paths.yaml beside the template.
config_path <- Sys.getenv("FINCOMMONS_CONFIG", "paths.yaml")

# The countries the report covers, as the repository codes them, or NULL for
# every country the lake holds. A country the pipeline has not collected has
# filings in the table of filings and no facts, and the report says so
# rather than leaving it out.
report_countries <- NULL

# The financial years shown, by the calendar year the period ends in, or
# NULL for the last `n_years` the lake holds. A financial year to 31 March
# 2026 counts as 2026 here, and is labelled 2025/26 wherever it is named.
report_years <- NULL
n_years <- 5

# The language of the report.
lang <- "en"

# How many months after the period end the annual financial report has to be
# public. Article 4 of the Transparency Directive says four, and every
# member state transposed it; a report measured against another deadline
# changes this.
deadline_months <- 4

# How many rows the rankings of concepts show.
top_n <- 20

# The point size of the text in a chart.
chart_base_size <- 9

# The month names in the captions come from the system locale rather than
# from the language set above, so the locale for dates is set from lang.
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", if (lang == "de") "German" else "C"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What counts as a concept of the taxonomy
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A fact names its concept by a prefix and a local name. These prefixes are
# the taxonomy every issuer tags against -- the IFRS taxonomy and ESMA's
# additions to it -- and a concept under any other prefix is one the issuer
# created for its own report. That distinction carries the whole report, so
# it is one list in one place: a lake that holds reports tagged against a
# taxonomy not named here would count them as extensions.
taxonomy_prefixes <- c("ifrs-full", "ifrs-smes", "esef_cor", "esef_all",
                       "ifrs", "esma")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The lines the report looks for
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# One row per concept, and a key that may have several rows: a line the
# taxonomy offers more than one concept for counts as tagged where the
# issuer tagged any of them. These are the lines of the primary statements
# that an analysis of several issuers rests on, and they are the lines the
# factsheet of a single issuer in this directory reads; the coverage of a
# line is therefore also the answer to how many issuers that factsheet could
# be built for.
#
# `statement` groups the lines: "pl" the statement of profit or loss, "sfp"
# the statement of financial position, "cf" the statement of cash flows.
lines <- tibble::tribble(
  ~key,                 ~CONCEPT,                                                       ~statement, ~en,                            ~de,
  "revenue",            "ifrs-full:Revenue",                                            "pl",  "Revenue",                           "Umsatzerlöse",
  "revenue",            "ifrs-full:RevenueFromContractsWithCustomers",                  "pl",  "Revenue",                           "Umsatzerlöse",
  "cost_of_sales",      "ifrs-full:CostOfSales",                                        "pl",  "Cost of sales",                     "Umsatzkosten",
  "gross_profit",       "ifrs-full:GrossProfit",                                        "pl",  "Gross profit",                      "Bruttoergebnis",
  "distribution_costs", "ifrs-full:DistributionCosts",                                  "pl",  "Distribution costs",                "Vertriebskosten",
  "admin_expense",      "ifrs-full:AdministrativeExpense",                              "pl",  "Administrative expenses",           "Verwaltungskosten",
  "employee_expense",   "ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense",                            "pl",  "Employee benefits expense",         "Personalaufwand",
  "depreciation",       "ifrs-full:DepreciationAndAmortisationExpense",                 "pl",  "Depreciation and amortisation",     "Abschreibungen",
  "ebit",               "ifrs-full:ProfitLossFromOperatingActivities",                  "pl",  "Operating result",                  "Betriebsergebnis",
  "finance_income",     "ifrs-full:FinanceIncome",                                      "pl",  "Finance income",                    "Finanzerträge",
  "finance_costs",      "ifrs-full:FinanceCosts",                                       "pl",  "Finance costs",                     "Finanzaufwendungen",
  "profit_before_tax",  "ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax",                                "pl",  "Profit before tax",                 "Ergebnis vor Steuern",
  "income_tax",         "ifrs-full:IncomeTaxExpenseContinuingOperations",                "pl",  "Income tax expense",                "Steueraufwand",
  "profit",             "ifrs-full:ProfitLoss",                                         "pl",  "Profit for the year",               "Jahresergebnis",
  "profit_owners",      "ifrs-full:ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent",             "pl",  "Profit attributable to the owners", "Ergebnis der Eigentümer",
  "eps",                "ifrs-full:BasicEarningsLossPerShare",                          "pl",  "Basic earnings per share",          "Ergebnis je Aktie",
  "assets",             "ifrs-full:Assets",                                             "sfp", "Total assets",                      "Bilanzsumme",
  "noncurrent_assets",  "ifrs-full:NoncurrentAssets",                                   "sfp", "Non-current assets",                "Langfristiges Vermögen",
  "current_assets",     "ifrs-full:CurrentAssets",                                      "sfp", "Current assets",                    "Kurzfristiges Vermögen",
  "ppe",                "ifrs-full:PropertyPlantAndEquipment",                          "sfp", "Property, plant and equipment",     "Sachanlagen",
  "ppe",                "ifrs-full:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentIncludingRightofuseAssets", "sfp", "Property, plant and equipment",     "Sachanlagen",
  "goodwill",           "ifrs-full:Goodwill",                                           "sfp", "Goodwill",                          "Firmenwert",
  "intangibles",        "ifrs-full:IntangibleAssetsOtherThanGoodwill",                  "sfp", "Other intangible assets",           "Sonstige immaterielle Vermögenswerte",
  "inventories",        "ifrs-full:Inventories",                                        "sfp", "Inventories",                       "Vorräte",
  "receivables",        "ifrs-full:TradeAndOtherCurrentReceivables",                    "sfp", "Trade and other receivables",       "Forderungen",
  "cash",               "ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents",                             "sfp", "Cash and cash equivalents",         "Zahlungsmittel",
  "equity",             "ifrs-full:Equity",                                             "sfp", "Equity",                            "Eigenkapital",
  "equity_owners",      "ifrs-full:EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent",                 "sfp", "Equity of the owners",              "Eigenkapital der Eigentümer",
  "issued_capital",     "ifrs-full:IssuedCapital",                                      "sfp", "Issued capital",                    "Grundkapital",
  "retained_earnings",  "ifrs-full:RetainedEarnings",                                   "sfp", "Retained earnings",                 "Gewinnrücklagen",
  "liabilities",        "ifrs-full:Liabilities",                                        "sfp", "Total liabilities",                 "Schulden",
  "noncurrent_liab",    "ifrs-full:NoncurrentLiabilities",                              "sfp", "Non-current liabilities",           "Langfristige Schulden",
  "current_liab",       "ifrs-full:CurrentLiabilities",                                 "sfp", "Current liabilities",               "Kurzfristige Schulden",
  "payables",           "ifrs-full:TradeAndOtherCurrentPayables",                       "sfp", "Trade and other payables",          "Verbindlichkeiten",
  "debt_noncurrent",    "ifrs-full:OtherNoncurrentFinancialLiabilities",                "sfp", "Non-current financial liabilities", "Langfristige Finanzschulden",
  "debt_noncurrent",    "ifrs-full:LongtermBorrowings",                                 "sfp", "Non-current financial liabilities", "Langfristige Finanzschulden",
  "debt_current",       "ifrs-full:OtherCurrentFinancialLiabilities",                   "sfp", "Current financial liabilities",     "Kurzfristige Finanzschulden",
  "debt_current",       "ifrs-full:ShorttermBorrowings",                                "sfp", "Current financial liabilities",     "Kurzfristige Finanzschulden",
  "ocf",                "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities",             "cf",  "Operating cash flow",               "Operativer Cashflow",
  "icf",                "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInInvestingActivities",             "cf",  "Investing cash flow",               "Cashflow aus Investitionen",
  "fcf_financing",      "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInFinancingActivities",             "cf",  "Financing cash flow",               "Cashflow aus Finanzierung",
  "interest_paid",      "ifrs-full:InterestPaidClassifiedAsOperatingActivities",        "cf",  "Interest paid",                     "Gezahlte Zinsen",
  "taxes_paid",         "ifrs-full:IncomeTaxesPaidRefundClassifiedAsOperatingActivities", "cf", "Income taxes paid",                "Gezahlte Steuern",
  "dividends_paid",     "ifrs-full:DividendsPaidClassifiedAsFinancingActivities",       "cf",  "Dividends paid",                    "Gezahlte Dividenden")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The indicators the report tests the record against
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# An indicator is feasible for an issuer and a year where every line it
# rests on was tagged. `prior` marks an indicator that compares a year with
# the one before it, which needs the lines of both years. The recipes are
# those of the factsheet in this directory, so that the share of issuers an
# indicator is feasible for is the share the factsheet's page on that
# indicator could be filled for.
#
# No indicator rests on EBITDA. Depreciation and amortisation are not a line
# of the primary statements under a concept of the taxonomy, so the cover
# ratios here stand against the operating result and the operating cash
# flow; the coverage of `depreciation` in the table of lines says how far an
# EBITDA could be reached at all.
indicators <- tibble::tribble(
  ~en,                           ~de,                               ~keys,                                                              ~prior,
  "Operating margin",            "EBIT-Marge",                      "revenue,ebit",                                                     FALSE,
  "Net margin",                   "Nettomarge",                     "revenue,profit",                                                   FALSE,
  "Gross margin",                 "Bruttomarge",                    "revenue,gross_profit",                                             FALSE,
  "Equity ratio",                 "Eigenkapitalquote",              "equity,assets",                                                    FALSE,
  "Gearing",                      "Verschuldungsgrad",              "debt_noncurrent,debt_current,cash,equity",                         FALSE,
  "Interest cover",               "Zinsdeckung",                    "ebit,finance_costs",                                               FALSE,
  "Current ratio",                "Liquidität 3. Grades",           "current_assets,current_liab",                                       FALSE,
  "Quick ratio",                  "Liquidität 2. Grades",           "current_assets,inventories,current_liab",                           FALSE,
  "Return on equity",             "Eigenkapitalrendite",            "profit_owners,equity_owners",                                      TRUE,
  "Return on assets",             "Gesamtkapitalrendite",           "profit,assets",                                                    TRUE,
  "Return on capital employed",   "Rendite auf eingesetztes Kapital", "ebit,assets,current_liab",                                       TRUE,
  "Cash flow to operating result", "Cashflow zum Betriebsergebnis",  "ocf,ebit",                                                         FALSE,
  "Accruals",                     "Periodenabgrenzungen",           "profit,ocf,icf,assets",                                            TRUE,
  "Cash conversion cycle",        "Geldumschlagsdauer",             "inventories,receivables,payables,revenue,cost_of_sales",            TRUE,
  "Earnings per share",           "Ergebnis je Aktie",              "eps",                                                              FALSE,
  "Piotroski F-score",            "Piotroski-F-Score",              "profit,ocf,assets,debt_noncurrent,current_assets,current_liab,issued_capital,gross_profit,revenue", TRUE,
  "Altman Z''-score",             "Altman-Z''-Score",               "current_assets,current_liab,retained_earnings,assets,ebit,equity,liabilities", FALSE)

# You can adapt your corporate design in the sourced R-Skript
library(ggplot2)
source("r-corporate-design-functions-ggplot2.R")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)

# The label of a financial year. A year that ends on 31 December is named by
# its calendar year, and any other by the two it spans: a financial year to
# 31 March 2026 is 2025/26.
fy_label <- function(date) {
  y <- as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  ifelse(format(date, "%m-%d") == "12-31", as.character(y),
         paste0(y - 1, "/", sprintf("%02d", y %% 100)))
}

# The day a deadline of whole months after a date falls on. A month is added
# by its name rather than by a number of days, because the deadline of a
# period ending on 31 December is 30 April and not the 1st of May, and the
# day is kept where the month it lands in is shorter: four months after
# 31 October is the last day of February.
add_months <- function(date, n) {
  lt <- as.POSIXlt(date)
  mday <- lt$mday
  lt$mday <- 1L
  lt$mon <- lt$mon + n
  start <- as.Date(lt)
  lt2 <- as.POSIXlt(start)
  lt2$mon <- lt2$mon + 1L
  len <- as.numeric(as.Date(lt2) - start)
  start + pmin(mday, len) - 1L
}

# The prefix of a concept, and whether it is one of the taxonomy.
prefix_of <- function(concept) sub(":.*$", "", concept)
local_name_of <- function(concept) sub("^[^:]*:", "", concept)
is_taxonomy <- function(concept) prefix_of(concept) %in% taxonomy_prefixes

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Silver layer
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

yaml_paths <- read_yaml(config_path)
path_silver <- yaml_paths[["esef"]][["silver"]]

# The Silver layer may name a schema in a catalogue rather than a directory,
# with the directory the tables are written to beside it. R reads files, so
# it takes the directory.
if (is.list(path_silver)) path_silver <- path_silver[["path"]]

# arrow reads every parquet file under a directory. A Delta table keeps the
# files it has replaced until it is vacuumed, and the table of facts replaces
# a country's partition on every run that finds new reports, so a Delta table
# read this way counts a fact once for every time it was written. This report
# counts facts, so it refuses one rather than show those counts.
for (table in c("filings", "facts")) {
  if (dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, table, "_delta_log"))) {
    stop("The ", table, " table of the esef module is a Delta table, which ",
         "this template does not read. Write the Silver layer as parquet, ",
         "or read the table through Spark.")
  }
}

filings_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "filings")) %>% collect()

if (nrow(filings_all) == 0) {
  stop("The table of filings of the esef module is empty. Run the pipeline ",
       "first: python -m fincommons.esef --config <paths.yaml> --country AT ",
       "--contact <you@example.org>")
}

# The countries and the years the report covers. A country named in the
# settings that the table does not list is an error rather than an empty
# column, because a report that silently covers less than it says is worse
# than one that does not render.
countries_held <- sort(unique(filings_all$COUNTRY))
if (is.null(report_countries)) {
  report_countries <- countries_held
} else {
  unknown <- setdiff(report_countries, countries_held)
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    stop("The table of filings lists no filing of ",
         paste(unknown, collapse = ", "), ". It lists ",
         paste(countries_held, collapse = ", "), ".")
  }
}

# The issuers the lake holds a filing for at all, before the countries and
# the years of this report narrow the table. The comparison with the market
# further down puts FIRDS against this rather than against the selection: a
# report on one country and one year would otherwise read as though the rest
# of the market had never filed.
leis_in_record <- unique(filings_all$LEI)
countries_in_record <- countries_held
years_in_record <- range(as.integer(format(filings_all$PERIODEND, "%Y")))

filings_all <- filings_all %>% filter(COUNTRY %in% report_countries)

years_held <- sort(unique(as.integer(format(filings_all$PERIODEND, "%Y"))))
if (is.null(report_years)) {
  report_years <- tail(years_held, n_years)
} else {
  report_years <- sort(intersect(report_years, years_held))
  if (length(report_years) == 0) {
    stop("The table of filings holds none of the financial years asked for. ",
         "It holds ", paste(range(years_held), collapse = " to "), ".")
  }
}

filings_all <- filings_all %>%
  mutate(fy = as.integer(format(PERIODEND, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(fy %in% report_years) %>%
  mutate(year = fy_label(PERIODEND),
         has_facts = !is.na(JSONURL),
         lag_days = as.numeric(as.Date(PUBLISHED) - PERIODEND),
         deadline = add_months(PERIODEND, deadline_months),
         late = as.Date(PUBLISHED) > deadline)

# One filing per issuer and financial year, which is what a cross-section
# counts: an issuer that filed its report in two languages, or filed it again
# with corrections, has a filing per language and per correction, each with
# facts of its own. The one kept is the one with facts, then the one with
# fewer validation errors, then the one the repository processed last. The
# language is not part of the choice here, as it is in the factsheet, because
# the figures of the two filings of a year are the same figures and this
# report reads no texts.
chosen <- filings_all %>%
  arrange(LEI, PERIODEND, !has_facts, coalesce(ERRORS, 0L), desc(PROCESSED)) %>%
  group_by(LEI, PERIODEND) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

selected <- chosen %>% filter(rank == 1, has_facts)
superseded <- chosen %>% filter(rank > 1)

if (nrow(selected) == 0) {
  stop("No filing of the countries and years asked for has facts. The ",
       "pipeline collects the indexes for every country and the reports ",
       "only for the countries it is given.")
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The facts
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Four queries, each of which arrow answers over the parquet files and hands
# back a result of the size of the market rather than of the size of the
# lake. The table of facts is the largest table of the module -- a year of
# the repository is a few thousand reports of a few thousand facts each --
# and none of these collects it.
facts_ds <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(FILING %in% selected$FILING)

# 1. One row per filing: how much was tagged, and how much of it under the
#    issuer's own concepts. A numeric fact is one with a value; everything
#    else is a text, and the text blocks of the notes are not in the table at
#    all.
per_filing <- facts_ds %>%
  group_by(FILING) %>%
  summarise(
    facts = n(),
    numeric_facts = sum(!is.na(VALUE)),
    text_facts = sum(is.na(VALUE)),
    dimensional = sum(!is.na(VALUE) & !is.na(DIMENSIONS)),
    own_facts = sum(!is.na(VALUE) & !startsWith(CONCEPT, "ifrs-full:")),
    concepts = n_distinct(CONCEPT)) %>%
  collect() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(selected %>% select(FILING, COUNTRY, LEI, NAME, PERIODEND, year, fy),
             by = "FILING") %>%
  mutate(own_share = own_facts / numeric_facts * 100)

# 2. Which concepts each issuer tagged, for the lines the report looks for.
#    The totals of the year the filing reports on: no dimensions, and a
#    period that ends on the period end of the filing. The comparative
#    figures of the year before, which every report carries as well, are
#    left aside, so that a line counts as tagged in the year it was reported
#    for and not in the year it was repeated in.
line_concepts <- unique(lines$CONCEPT)
tagged_lines <- facts_ds %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), is.na(DIMENSIONS), PRDEND == PERIODEND,
         CONCEPT %in% line_concepts) %>%
  distinct(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, CONCEPT) %>%
  collect() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(lines %>% select(key, CONCEPT), by = "CONCEPT", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  distinct(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, key)

# 3. How many issuers tag each concept of the taxonomy, by financial year:
#    the common ground of the market, which is what a cross-section can be
#    built on at all.
concept_reach <- facts_ds %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), is.na(DIMENSIONS), PRDEND == PERIODEND) %>%
  distinct(PERIODEND, LEI, CONCEPT) %>%
  group_by(PERIODEND, CONCEPT) %>%
  summarise(issuers = n()) %>%
  collect() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(fy = as.integer(format(PERIODEND, "%Y")),
         year = fy_label(PERIODEND))

# 4. The concepts the issuers created themselves, one row per issuer and
#    concept. The local name is all there is to go on: the label an issuer
#    gives a concept is in the taxonomy of its report package, which the
#    Silver layer does not hold, so two issuers are counted as having
#    invented the same thing only where they spelt it the same way.
own_concepts <- facts_ds %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), !startsWith(CONCEPT, "ifrs-full:")) %>%
  distinct(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, CONCEPT) %>%
  collect() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is_taxonomy(CONCEPT)) %>%
  mutate(local = local_name_of(CONCEPT),
         fy = as.integer(format(PERIODEND, "%Y")))

# The prefixes the facts are tagged against, which says whether the list in
# the settings above covers this lake.
prefix_census <- facts_ds %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE)) %>%
  mutate(prefix = sub(":.*$", "", CONCEPT)) %>%
  count(prefix) %>%
  collect() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(taxonomy = prefix %in% taxonomy_prefixes) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The lines and the indicators, per issuer and year
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

lines_meta <- lines %>%
  distinct(key, statement, en, de) %>%
  mutate(label = if (lang == "de") de else en)
line_keys <- lines_meta$key
n_lines <- length(line_keys)

# One row per issuer, year and line, true where the line was tagged. Every
# combination is present, so that a line nobody tagged is a row of FALSE
# rather than a row that is missing.
issuer_years <- selected %>% distinct(COUNTRY, LEI, NAME, PERIODEND, year, fy)

presence <- issuer_years %>%
  select(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, fy) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(key = line_keys) %>%
  left_join(tagged_lines %>% mutate(found = TRUE),
            by = c("COUNTRY", "LEI", "PERIODEND", "key")) %>%
  mutate(found = coalesce(found, FALSE))

# The coverage of a line: the share of the issuers of a year that tagged it.
line_coverage <- presence %>%
  group_by(fy, key) %>%
  summarise(issuers = n(), found = sum(found), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share = found / issuers * 100) %>%
  left_join(lines_meta, by = "key")

# How many of the lines each issuer tagged.
per_issuer <- presence %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, fy) %>%
  summarise(found = sum(found), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share = found / n_lines * 100)

# Whether an indicator could be computed for an issuer and a year: every
# line it rests on tagged, and, where it compares a year with the one
# before it, tagged in that year as well. The year before is the issuer's
# own previous filing, which for an issuer that did not file is missing and
# leaves the indicator infeasible rather than feasible by default.
found_wide <- presence %>%
  select(COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, fy, key, found) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "key", values_from = "found")

has_keys <- function(data, keys) {
  if (length(keys) == 0) return(rep(TRUE, nrow(data)))
  Reduce(`&`, lapply(keys, function(k) data[[k]]))
}

prior_year <- found_wide %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY, LEI) %>%
  arrange(PERIODEND, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(line_keys), ~ lag(.x) & (fy - lag(fy)) == 1,
                .names = "prior_{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup()

indicator_coverage <- indicators %>%
  mutate(label = if (lang == "de") de else en) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    row <- .
    keys <- trimws(strsplit(row$keys, ",")[[1]])
    ok <- has_keys(prior_year, keys)
    if (row$prior) {
      ok <- ok & has_keys(prior_year, paste0("prior_", keys))
    }
    tibble(label = row$label, n_keys = length(keys), prior = row$prior,
           fy = prior_year$fy, feasible = coalesce(ok, FALSE))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(label, n_keys, prior, fy) %>%
  summarise(issuers = n(), feasible = sum(feasible), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share = feasible / issuers * 100)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The figures the cover and the prose quote
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

years <- selected %>%
  distinct(PERIODEND, year, fy) %>%
  arrange(fy, PERIODEND) %>%
  distinct(fy, .keep_all = TRUE)
year_labels <- as.character(report_years)
latest_fy <- max(report_years)
n_filings <- nrow(filings_all)
n_selected <- nrow(selected)
n_issuers <- length(unique(selected$LEI))
n_facts <- sum(per_filing$facts)
n_numeric <- sum(per_filing$numeric_facts)
max_date <- max(selected$PERIODEND)
period_range <- paste0(min(report_years), " – ", max(report_years))

latest <- per_filing %>% filter(fy == latest_fy)
latest_issuers <- per_issuer %>% filter(fy == latest_fy)
own_share_latest <- if (nrow(latest) > 0)
  sum(latest$own_facts) / sum(latest$numeric_facts) * 100 else NA_real_
median_lines_latest <- if (nrow(latest_issuers) > 0)
  median(latest_issuers$found) else NA_real_
late_share <- mean(filings_all$late, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
no_facts_share <- mean(!filings_all$has_facts) * 100
```

```{r formats}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Writing numbers and words
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

big_mark <- if (lang == "de") "." else ","
decimal_mark <- if (lang == "de") "," else "."

fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & abs(x) < 0.5 / 10^digits, 0, x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "–",
         formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = big_mark,
                 decimal.mark = decimal_mark))
}

fmt_signed <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "–",
         paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""),
                formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = big_mark,
                        decimal.mark = decimal_mark)))
}

# Translate a label: `tr("Filings", "Einreichungen")`.
tr <- function(en, de) if (lang == "de") de else en

wrap_caption <- function(text, width = 125) {
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}

source_caption <- caption_corporate_design(
  source = tr("ESEF annual financial reports, filings.xbrl.org.",
              "ESEF-Finanzberichte, filings.xbrl.org."),
  last = format(max_date, tr("%d %b %Y", "%d.%m.%Y")),
  lang = lang)

typst_string <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)
  gsub("\"", "\\\\\"", x)
}

# A table of one row per item and one column per financial year, which most
# of this report's tables are.
render_years <- function(data, value, digits = 0, label_column = "label",
                         header = "", order = NULL) {
  wide <- data %>%
    mutate(.v = {{ value }}) %>%
    select(all_of(label_column), fy, .v) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "fy", values_from = ".v")
  if (!is.null(order)) {
    wide <- wide[match(order, wide[[label_column]]), ]
    wide[[label_column]] <- order
  }
  out <- tibble(item = wide[[label_column]])
  for (y in report_years) {
    column <- as.character(y)
    out[[column]] <- if (column %in% names(wide)) fmt(wide[[column]], digits)
                     else "–"
  }
  knitr::kable(out, col.names = c(header, year_labels),
               align = paste0("l", strrep("r", length(report_years))))
}

# A chart of one line per group over the financial years.
chart_by_year <- function(data, value, group, subtitle = "%", digits = 0,
                          ncol = 5, zero = TRUE) {
  d <- data %>% mutate(.v = {{ value }}, .g = {{ group }}) %>% filter(!is.na(.v))
  g <- ggplot(d, aes(x = fy, y = .v, colour = .g)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = linewidth_corporate_design) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = report_years, labels = year_labels,
                       expand = c(.02, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) fmt(x, digits)) +
    scale_colour_corporate_design() +
    labs(caption = wrap_caption(source_caption), subtitle = subtitle) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = ncol)) +
    theme_corporate_design(base_size = chart_base_size,
                           axis.title = element_blank())
  if (zero) g <- g + geom_zeroline()
  g
}

# A chart of bars, one per category, read from top to bottom.
chart_ranked <- function(data, value, label, subtitle = "%", digits = 0,
                         wrap = 44) {
  d <- data %>%
    mutate(.v = {{ value }}, .l = wrap_labels({{ label }}, wrap)) %>%
    arrange(.v) %>%
    mutate(.l = factor(.l, levels = .l))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .v, y = .l)) +
    geom_col(fill = palette_corporate_design("cat")[1], width = 0.72) +
    geom_zeroline(x = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) fmt(x, digits),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .06))) +
    labs(caption = wrap_caption(source_caption), subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_corporate_design(base_size = chart_base_size, grid = "x",
                           axis.title = element_blank())
}
```

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The cover and the running head
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

ts <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) x <- "–"
  paste0("\"", typst_string(as.character(x)), "\"")
}

typst_kv <- function(items) {
  rows <- vapply(seq_along(items), function(i) {
    paste0("  text(size: 7.5pt, fill: soft, ", ts(names(items)[i]), "),\n",
           "  text(size: 8.5pt, ", ts(items[[i]]), "),")
  }, character(1))
  paste0("#grid(columns: (3.5cm, 1fr), row-gutter: 5.5pt, column-gutter: 6pt,\n",
         paste(rows, collapse = "\n"), "\n)")
}

```{r basis, results='asis'}
basis <- c(

            "of every report the pipeline collected. It covers ",
            length(report_countries), " countries and the financial years ",
            period_range, ": ", fmt(n_filings), " filings, of which ",
            fmt(n_selected), " reports of ", fmt(n_issuers),
            " issuers carry facts, and ", fmt(n_facts), " facts in all. ",
            "Every number in this report is a count of facts, filings or ",
            "issuers. Not one is an amount out of a report."),
     paste0("**Was gezählt wird.** Der Bericht liest die beiden ",
            "Silver-Tabellen des Moduls `esef` von fincommons: eine Zeile ",
            "je in den Verzeichnissen von filings.xbrl.org gelisteter ",
            "Einreichung und eine Zeile je ausgezeichnetem Fakt jedes ",
            "eingesammelten Berichts. Er umfasst ", length(report_countries),
            " Länder und die Geschäftsjahre ", period_range, ": ",
            fmt(n_filings), " Einreichungen, davon ", fmt(n_selected),
            " Berichte von ", fmt(n_issuers), " Emittenten mit Fakten, und ",

            "Bericht ist eine Anzahl von Fakten, Einreichungen oder ",

  tr(paste("**One report per issuer and year.** An issuer may file the same",
           "report twice -- in two languages, or again with corrections --",
           "and each filing carries facts of its own. A cross-section",
           "counts an issuer once per financial year, so the report kept",
           "is the one with facts, then the one with fewer validation",
           "errors, then the one the repository processed last. The",
           "filings set aside this way are counted in their own right in",
           "section 1."),
     paste("**Ein Bericht je Emittent und Jahr.** Ein Emittent kann denselben",
           "Bericht zweimal einreichen -- in zwei Sprachen oder korrigiert",
           "--, und jede Einreichung trägt eigene Fakten. Ein Querschnitt",
           "zählt einen Emittenten einmal je Geschäftsjahr, also wird die",
           "Einreichung mit Fakten behalten, dann die mit weniger",
           "Validierungsfehlern, dann die zuletzt verarbeitete. Die so",
           "beiseitegelegten Einreichungen werden in Abschnitt 1 eigens",
           "gezählt.")),
  tr(paste("**The figures of the year, not the comparatives.** A report",
           "states the figures of the year it reports on and the",
           "comparative figures of the year before. A line counts as tagged",
           "in the year it was reported for: the facts counted are those",
           "without dimensions whose period ends on the period end of the",
           "filing. A fact tagged twice in one report, in the statements",
           "and again in the notes, counts once."),
     paste("**Die Zahlen des Jahres, nicht die Vorjahreszahlen.** Ein",

           "werden die Fakten ohne Dimensionen, deren Periode auf den",

           "zweimal ausgezeichnet ist, in den Abschlüssen und erneut in den",
           "Erläuterungen, zählt einmal.")),
  tr(paste0("**A concept of the taxonomy, or one of the issuer's own.** A ",

            paste0("`", taxonomy_prefixes, "`", collapse = ", "),
            " -- the IFRS taxonomy and ESMA's additions to it -- and ",
            "everything else is a concept the issuer created for its own ",

cat(paste(basis, collapse = "\n\n"))
```

```{r record-countries}
# One row per country: what the indexes list, how much of it carries facts,
# and how much was set aside as a second filing of a year. A country whose
# reports the pipeline was never given stands here with filings and without
# facts, which is a statement about the lake and not about the country.
by_country <- filings_all %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(filings = n(),
            issuers = n_distinct(LEI),
            no_facts = sum(!has_facts),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(selected %>%
              group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
              summarise(read = n(), read_issuers = n_distinct(LEI),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = "COUNTRY") %>%
  left_join(superseded %>% count(COUNTRY, name = "second"), by = "COUNTRY") %>%
  left_join(per_filing %>%
              group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
              summarise(facts = sum(facts), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "COUNTRY") %>%
  mutate(across(c(read, read_issuers, second, facts), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))

temp <- by_country %>%
  mutate(per_report = ifelse(read > 0, facts / read, NA)) %>%
  transmute(COUNTRY,
            filings = fmt(filings),
            issuers = fmt(issuers),
            second = fmt(second),
            no_facts = fmt(no_facts),
            read = fmt(read),
            facts = fmt(facts),
            per_report = fmt(per_report))

knitr::kable(temp, align = "lrrrrrrr", col.names = c(
  tr("Country", "Land"),
  tr("Filings", "Einreichungen"),
  tr("Issuers", "Emittenten"),
  tr("Second of a year", "Zweite des Jahres"),
  tr("No facts", "Ohne Fakten"),
  tr("Reports read", "Gelesene Berichte"),
  tr("Facts", "Fakten"),
  tr("Per report", "Je Bericht")))
```

### `r tr("What the repository's validation found", "Was die Validierung des Repository fand")`

```{r validation}
# The repository validates every filing it takes in and records what the
# check found. These are its counts, not this report's: an inconsistency is
# a calculation in the filing that does not add up, which is a warning
# rather than an error, and the repository publishes the filing either way.
validation <- filings_all %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(filings = n(),
            with_errors = mean(coalesce(ERRORS, 0L) > 0) * 100,
            with_warnings = mean(coalesce(WARNINGS, 0L) > 0) * 100,
            with_inconsistencies = mean(coalesce(INCONSISTENCIES, 0L) > 0) * 100,
            median_inconsistencies = median(coalesce(INCONSISTENCIES, 0L)),
            .groups = "drop")

temp <- validation %>%
  transmute(COUNTRY, filings = fmt(filings),
            with_errors = fmt(with_errors, 1),
            with_warnings = fmt(with_warnings, 1),
            with_inconsistencies = fmt(with_inconsistencies, 1),
            median_inconsistencies = fmt(median_inconsistencies))

knitr::kable(temp, align = "lrrrrr", col.names = c(
  tr("Country", "Land"),
  tr("Filings", "Einreichungen"),
  tr("With an error, %", "Mit Fehler, %"),
  tr("With a warning, %", "Mit Warnung, %"),
  tr("With an inconsistency, %", "Mit Inkonsistenz, %"),
  tr("Inconsistencies, med.", "Inkonsistenzen, Med.")))
```

### `r tr("The record against the market", "Das Register gegen den Markt")`

```{r firds, results='asis'}
# How many issuers the record is missing. The table of filings lists the
# issuers whose reports reached the repository; FIRDS lists the shares
# admitted to trading in the Union, and the issuer of each. The comparison
# is the one check of this report that reaches outside the module, and it
# needs the firds module's Silver layer in the same config file.
#
# Two things to read it with. A share with a record in force in FIRDS is not
# the same population as an issuer required to file an annual financial
# report in ESEF: the compact table carries no flag for admission to a
# regulated market at the issuer's request, so the count here is of every
# issuer of a share FIRDS still holds a record for, which is the wider
# population. And FIRDS is a register of the Union: the United Kingdom and
# Ukraine, whose filings the repository also collects, are not in it.
firds_silver <- tryCatch(yaml_paths[["firds"]][["silver"]], error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.list(firds_silver)) firds_silver <- firds_silver[["path"]]
firds_compact <- if (is.null(firds_silver)) NULL else
  file.path(firds_silver, "compact")

if (is.null(firds_compact) || !dir.exists(firds_compact)) {
  cat(tr(paste("The config file names no Silver layer of the `firds` module,",
               "or it holds no compact table, so this comparison is left",
               "out. Build it with `firds.update_from_silver_main_to_silver_compact`",
               "and render again to see how many issuers of shares admitted",
               "to trading in the Union have no annual financial report in",
               "the record."),
         paste("Die Konfigurationsdatei nennt keinen Silver-Layer des Moduls",
               "`firds`, oder dieser enthält keine compact-Tabelle, daher",
               "entfällt dieser Vergleich. Erstellen Sie sie mit",
               "`firds.update_from_silver_main_to_silver_compact` und",
               "rendern Sie erneut, um zu sehen, wie viele Emittenten von",
               "zum Handel in der Union zugelassenen Aktien keinen",
               "Finanzbericht im Register haben.")))
} else if (dir.exists(file.path(firds_compact, "_delta_log"))) {
  cat(tr(paste("The compact table of the `firds` module is a Delta table,",
               "which this template does not read. Write it as parquet, or",
               "read it through Spark."),
         paste("Die compact-Tabelle des Moduls `firds` ist eine",
               "Delta-Tabelle, die diese Vorlage nicht liest. Schreiben Sie",
               "sie als Parquet oder lesen Sie sie über Spark.")))
} else {
  shares <- open_dataset(firds_compact) %>%
    select(ISIN, CFI, ISSUER) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ISSUER)) %>%
    collect() %>%
    # The CFI of an ISIN joins what the trading venues state with a plus, so
    # a share is one whose CFI begins with ES at any of them.
    filter(grepl("(^|\\+)ES", CFI)) %>%
    distinct(ISSUER)

  filed <- leis_in_record
  market <- shares$ISSUER
  record_scope <- paste0(paste(countries_in_record, collapse = ", "), ", ",
                         paste(unique(years_in_record), collapse = " to "))
  cat(tr(
    paste0("FIRDS holds a share with a record in force for ", fmt(length(market)),
           " issuers. Of those, ", fmt(sum(market %in% filed)),
           " are in the record of filings -- ",
           fmt(mean(market %in% filed) * 100, 1), " per cent. The record ",
           "also holds ", fmt(sum(!filed %in% market)),
           " issuers that FIRDS holds no share for, which an issuer of ",
           "listed debt alone, an issuer outside the Union, and an issuer ",
           "whose shares have since been delisted all are. Both counts are ",
           "taken over the whole record the lake holds -- ", record_scope,
           " -- and not over the countries and years of this report, which ",
           "would read as though the rest of the market had never filed. ",
           "FIRDS covers the Union, so a lake built for some of its ",
           "countries shows the issuers of the others as missing; the share ",
           "above is a lower bound for the countries collected and says ",
           "nothing about the rest."),
    paste0("FIRDS hält für ", fmt(length(market)),
           " Emittenten eine Aktie mit gültigem Datensatz. Davon stehen ",
           fmt(sum(market %in% filed)), " im Einreichungsregister -- ",
           fmt(mean(market %in% filed) * 100, 1),
           " Prozent. Das Register führt außerdem ",
           fmt(sum(!filed %in% market)),
           " Emittenten, für die FIRDS keine Aktie hält, was auf einen ",
           "Emittenten nur börsennotierter Schuldtitel, einen Emittenten ",
           "außerhalb der Union und einen Emittenten zutrifft, dessen ",
           "Aktien inzwischen nicht mehr notiert sind. Beide Zahlen sind ",
           "über das gesamte im Lake vorhandene Register gezählt -- ",
           record_scope, " -- und nicht über die Länder und Jahre dieses ",
           "Berichts, was so zu lesen wäre, als hätte der übrige Markt nie ",
           "eingereicht. FIRDS deckt die Union ab, daher zeigt ein Lake für ",
           "einen Teil ihrer Länder die Emittenten der übrigen als fehlend; ",
           "der Anteil oben ist eine Untergrenze für die eingesammelten ",
           "Länder und sagt nichts über die übrigen.")))
}
```

### `r tr("The facts of a report", "Die Fakten eines Berichts")`

```{r facts-per-report}
# What a report holds, per financial year and as a median over the reports
# of the year. The text blocks of the notes are not in the table: they are
# most of a report by size, and the Silver layer leaves them out, so a text
# here is a short one -- the name of the entity, its domicile, the currency.
facts_year <- per_filing %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  summarise(reports = n(),
            facts = median(facts),
            numeric_facts = median(numeric_facts),
            dimensional = median(dimensional),
            text_facts = median(text_facts),
            concepts = median(concepts),
            own = median(own_facts),
            .groups = "drop")

temp <- tibble(item = c(
  tr("Reports read", "Gelesene Berichte"),
  tr("Facts", "Fakten"),
  tr("of which numeric", "davon numerisch"),
  tr("of which with dimensions", "davon mit Dimensionen"),
  tr("of which texts", "davon Texte"),
  tr("Distinct concepts", "Verschiedene Konzepte"),
  tr("Facts under the issuer's own concepts", "Fakten unter eigenen Konzepten")))
for (y in report_years) {
  row <- facts_year %>% filter(fy == y)
  temp[[as.character(y)]] <- if (nrow(row) == 0) rep("–", 7) else
    c(fmt(row$reports), fmt(row$facts), fmt(row$numeric_facts),
      fmt(row$dimensional), fmt(row$text_facts), fmt(row$concepts),
      fmt(row$own))
}
knitr::kable(temp, col.names = c(tr("Median per report", "Median je Bericht"),
                                 year_labels),
             align = paste0("l", strrep("r", length(report_years))))
```

```{r prefixes}
# Every prefix the facts carry, with the ones this report counts as the

own <- prefix_census %>% filter(!taxonomy)

temp <- bind_rows(temp, tibble(
```

```{r own-share-bands}
# The distribution across the reports of the latest year, because a median
# hides the issuers an analysis would struggle with most.
bands <- c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20, 100)
band_labels <- c("0 – 2 %", "2 – 5 %", "5 – 10 %", "10 – 20 %", "> 20 %")

temp <- per_filing %>%
  filter(!is.na(own_share)) %>%
  mutate(band = cut(own_share, breaks = bands, labels = band_labels,
                    include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) %>%
  count(fy, band, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(label = band)

render_years(temp, share, digits = 1,
             header = tr("Reports by own concepts, %",
                         "Berichte nach eigenen Konzepten, %"),
```

### `r tr("How many of the lines an issuer tags", "Wie viele der Zeilen ein Emittent auszeichnet")`

```{r lines-per-issuer}
quantiles <- per_issuer %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  summarise(reports = n(),
            p10 = quantile(found, 0.1),
            median = median(found),
            p90 = quantile(found, 0.9), .groups = "drop")

# Per statement, two measures of the same thing: how much of it a typical
# report tags, and how many reports tag all of it. The second is the harder
# test by far -- a statement here is every line of it, including the ones
# few issuers tag at all -- and it is the one an analysis that cannot
# tolerate a gap has to pass.
by_statement <- presence %>%
  left_join(lines_meta %>% select(key, statement), by = "key") %>%
  group_by(fy, COUNTRY, LEI, PERIODEND, statement) %>%
  summarise(share = mean(found) * 100, all_found = all(found),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(fy, statement) %>%
  summarise(median_share = median(share), complete = mean(all_found) * 100,
            .groups = "drop")

statement_labels <- c(pl = tr("income statement", "Ergebnisrechnung"),
                      sfp = tr("balance sheet", "Bilanz"),
                      cf = tr("cash flow statement", "Kapitalflussrechnung"))

temp <- tibble(item = c(
  tr("Reports read", "Gelesene Berichte"),
  tr("Lines found, 10th percentile", "Gefundene Zeilen, 10. Perzentil"),
  tr("Lines found, median", "Gefundene Zeilen, Median"),
  tr("Lines found, 90th percentile", "Gefundene Zeilen, 90. Perzentil"),
  tr(paste0("Of the ", statement_labels[["pl"]], ", tagged, median %"),
     paste0("Von der ", statement_labels[["pl"]], " ausgezeichnet, Median %")),
  tr(paste0("Of the ", statement_labels[["sfp"]], ", tagged, median %"),
     paste0("Von der ", statement_labels[["sfp"]], " ausgezeichnet, Median %")),
  tr(paste0("Of the ", statement_labels[["cf"]], ", tagged, median %"),
     paste0("Von der ", statement_labels[["cf"]], " ausgezeichnet, Median %")),
  tr("With every line of the income statement, %",
     "Mit allen Zeilen der Ergebnisrechnung, %"),
  tr("With every line of the balance sheet, %",
     "Mit allen Zeilen der Bilanz, %"),
  tr("With every line of the cash flow statement, %",
     "Mit allen Zeilen der Kapitalflussrechnung, %")))
for (y in report_years) {
  q <- quantiles %>% filter(fy == y)
  s <- by_statement %>% filter(fy == y)
  value_of <- function(st, column) {
    v <- s[[column]][s$statement == st]
    if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else v
  }
  temp[[as.character(y)]] <- if (nrow(q) == 0) rep("–", 10) else c(
    fmt(q$reports),
    paste0(fmt(q$p10), " / ", n_lines),
    paste0(fmt(q$median), " / ", n_lines),
    paste0(fmt(q$p90), " / ", n_lines),
    fmt(value_of("pl", "median_share"), 1),
    fmt(value_of("sfp", "median_share"), 1),
    fmt(value_of("cf", "median_share"), 1),
    fmt(value_of("pl", "complete"), 1),
    fmt(value_of("sfp", "complete"), 1),
    fmt(value_of("cf", "complete"), 1))
}
knitr::kable(temp, col.names = c("", year_labels),
             align = paste0("l", strrep("r", length(report_years))))
```

## `r tr("4 What this report cannot say", "4 Was dieser Bericht nicht sagen kann")`

```{r limits, results='asis'}
limits <- c(
  tr(paste("**Which statement a line stood in.** A fact in xBRL-JSON carries",
           "its concept, its period, its unit and its dimensions, and",
           "nothing that says where in the report it was presented. The",
           "statements in section 3 are this report's grouping of the",
           "concepts, not the issuers' own presentation, and a concept an",
           "issuer tagged only in its notes counts the same as one it",
           "presented on the face of a statement."),
     paste("**In welchem Abschluss eine Zeile stand.** Ein Fakt in xBRL-JSON",
           "trägt sein Konzept, seine Periode, seine Einheit und seine",
           "Dimensionen und nichts, was sagt, wo im Bericht er dargestellt",
           "war. Die Abschlüsse in Abschnitt 3 sind die Gruppierung dieses",
           "Berichts, nicht die Darstellung der Emittenten, und ein Konzept,",
           "das ein Emittent nur in den Erläuterungen ausgezeichnet hat,",
           "zählt wie eines in einem Hauptabschluss.")),
  tr(paste("**What an extension was anchored to.** ESMA requires an issuer",
           "to anchor a concept of its own to a wider concept of the",
           "taxonomy, which is what makes an extension readable at all. The",
           "anchoring is a relationship in the taxonomy of the report",
           "package; the Silver layer holds the facts, so this report counts",
           "extensions and says nothing about where they were anchored. The",
           "same goes for the calculation relationships, which is why this",
           "report makes no check that a statement adds up."),
     paste("**Woran eine Erweiterung verankert wurde.** Die ESMA verlangt,",
           "ein eigenes Konzept an ein weiteres Konzept der Taxonomie zu",
           "verankern, was eine Erweiterung überhaupt lesbar macht. Die",
           "Verankerung ist eine Beziehung in der Taxonomie des",
           "Berichtspakets; der Silver-Layer hält die Fakten, daher zählt",
           "dieser Bericht Erweiterungen und sagt nichts darüber, wo sie",
           "verankert wurden. Dasselbe gilt für die",
           "Berechnungsbeziehungen, weshalb dieser Bericht nicht prüft, ob",
           "ein Abschluss aufgeht.")),
  tr(paste("**What an issuer called a concept.** A label is in the taxonomy",
           "of the package as well. The ranking of the concepts the issuers",
           "invent is therefore a ranking of local names, and two issuers",
           "that tagged the same line under names spelt differently are two",
           "rows of that table rather than one."),
     paste("**Wie ein Emittent ein Konzept genannt hat.** Eine Bezeichnung",
           "steht ebenfalls in der Taxonomie des Pakets. Die Rangfolge der",
           "von den Emittenten erfundenen Konzepte ist daher eine Rangfolge",
           "lokaler Namen, und zwei Emittenten, die dieselbe Zeile unter",
           "unterschiedlich geschriebenen Namen ausgezeichnet haben, sind",
           "zwei Zeilen jener Tabelle und nicht eine.")),
  tr(paste("**The notes.** Most of a report by size is its notes, tagged",
           "whole as text blocks, and the Silver layer leaves them out: a",
           "single note on intangible assets can be half a megabyte of",
           "HTML. The counts of texts in section 2 are therefore counts of",
           "short texts, and nothing here measures the tagging of the",
           "notes. The Bronze layer keeps the whole report."),
     paste("**Die Erläuterungen.** Der größte Teil eines Berichts sind",
           "seine Erläuterungen, die als Textblöcke ganz ausgezeichnet",
           "werden, und der Silver-Layer lässt sie aus: eine einzige",
           "Erläuterung zu immateriellen Vermögenswerten kann ein halbes",
           "Megabyte HTML sein. Die Textzählungen in Abschnitt 2 sind daher",
           "Zählungen kurzer Texte, und nichts hier misst die Auszeichnung",
           "der Erläuterungen. Der Bronze-Layer hält den ganzen Bericht.")),
  tr(paste("**Whether a tag is right.** A line counted as tagged is a line",
           "the issuer tagged, not a line tagged correctly. A value with the",
           "wrong sign, a balance dated at the start of the following period",
           "and a figure tagged at the wrong scale all count here as",
           "coverage. The counts the repository's own validation produced",
           "are in section 1 and are the nearest thing in this report to a",
           "judgement on quality."),
     paste("**Ob eine Auszeichnung richtig ist.** Eine als ausgezeichnet",
           "gezählte Zeile ist eine, die der Emittent ausgezeichnet hat,",
           "nicht eine richtig ausgezeichnete. Ein Wert mit falschem",
           "Vorzeichen, ein Bestand mit dem Datum des Folgetags und eine",
           "Zahl in falscher Größenordnung zählen hier alle als Abdeckung.",
           "Die Zählungen der Validierung des Repository stehen in",
           "Abschnitt 1 und sind das Nächste zu einem Qualitätsurteil in",
           "diesem Bericht.")),
  tr(paste("**The market, as against the record.** The repository collects",
           "what the officially appointed mechanisms publish, and it says",
           "itself that it cannot be comprehensive: for most member states",
           "there is no API to index from, and some countries' filings",
           "cannot be downloaded from it at all. A share of issuers in",
           "section 3 is a share of the reports in the record, and the",
           "comparison with FIRDS in section 1 is the only measure here of",
           "how far the record reaches the market."),
     paste("**Der Markt, gegenüber dem Register.** Das Repository sammelt,",
           "was die amtlich bestellten Mechanismen veröffentlichen, und sagt",
           "selbst, dass es nicht vollständig sein kann: für die meisten",
           "Mitgliedstaaten gibt es keine Schnittstelle zum Indexieren, und",
           "die Einreichungen einiger Länder lassen sich überhaupt nicht",
           "herunterladen. Ein Emittentenanteil in Abschnitt 3 ist ein",
           "Anteil der Berichte im Register, und der Vergleich mit FIRDS in",
           "Abschnitt 1 ist hier das einzige Maß dafür, wie weit das",
           "Register den Markt erreicht.")))

cat(paste(limits, collapse = "\n\n"))
```

## `r tr("5 The record read", "5 Das gelesene Register")`

### `r tr("The run", "Der Lauf")`

```{r run}
temp <- tibble(
  item = c(tr("Silver layer", "Silver-Layer"),
           tr("Countries", "Länder"),
           tr("Financial years", "Geschäftsjahre"),
           tr("Filings listed", "Gelistete Einreichungen"),
           tr("Of those, without facts", "Davon ohne Fakten"),
           tr("Of those, a second filing of a year",
              "Davon zweite Einreichung eines Jahres"),
           tr("Reports read", "Gelesene Berichte"),
           tr("Issuers", "Emittenten"),
           tr("Facts read", "Gelesene Fakten"),
           tr("Of those, numeric", "Davon numerisch"),
           tr("Lines looked for", "Gesuchte Zeilen"),
           tr("Indicators tested", "Geprüfte Kennzahlen"),
           tr("Rendered on", "Erstellt am")),
  value = c(path_silver,
            paste(report_countries, collapse = ", "),
            period_range,
            fmt(n_filings),
            fmt(sum(!filings_all$has_facts)),
            fmt(nrow(superseded)),
            fmt(n_selected),
            fmt(n_issuers),
            fmt(n_facts),
            fmt(n_numeric),
            fmt(n_lines),
            fmt(nrow(indicators)),
            format(Sys.Date(), tr("%d %B %Y", "%d.%m.%Y"))))

knitr::kable(temp, col.names = c("", ""), align = "lr")
```

### `r tr("The lines looked for, and the concepts of each", "Die gesuchten Zeilen und ihre Konzepte")`

```{r lines-list}
temp <- lines %>%
  mutate(label = if (lang == "de") de else en) %>%
  group_by(label, statement) %>%
  summarise(concepts = paste0("`", paste(CONCEPT, collapse = "`, `"), "`"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(match(statement, c("pl", "sfp", "cf")), label) %>%
  transmute(statement = recode(statement,
                               pl = tr("Profit or loss", "Ergebnis"),
                               sfp = tr("Financial position", "Bilanz"),
                               cf = tr("Cash flows", "Cashflow")),
            label, concepts)

knitr::kable(temp, align = "lll", col.names = c(
  tr("Statement", "Abschluss"),
  tr("Line", "Zeile"),
  tr("Concepts looked for", "Gesuchte Konzepte")))
```

### `r tr("Sources", "Quellen")`

```{r sources, results='asis'}
sources <- c(
  tr(paste("**The filings and the reports.** filings.xbrl.org, run by XBRL",
           "International, which collects the reports filed with the",
           "officially appointed mechanism of each member state, validates",
           "them and publishes for each filing the report package as filed,",
           "the report in a viewer and the tagged facts as xBRL-JSON. The",
           "repository also holds the reports of the United Kingdom, filed",
           "as UKSEF, and of Ukraine. It states no licence for its copies;",
           "the reports are the issuers' own publications, which the",
           "Transparency Directive requires them to make public."),
     paste("**Die Einreichungen und die Berichte.** filings.xbrl.org,",
           "betrieben von XBRL International, sammelt die bei den amtlich",
           "bestellten Mechanismen der Mitgliedstaaten eingereichten",
           "Berichte, validiert sie und veröffentlicht je Einreichung das",
           "Berichtspaket wie eingereicht, den Bericht in einem Viewer und",
           "die ausgezeichneten Fakten als xBRL-JSON. Das Repository hält",
           "auch die Berichte des Vereinigten Königreichs, als UKSEF",
           "eingereicht, und der Ukraine. Es nennt keine Lizenz für seine",
           "Kopien; die Berichte sind die Veröffentlichungen der Emittenten,",
           "zu denen die Transparenzrichtlinie sie verpflichtet.")),
  tr(paste("**The format.** Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/815,",
           "the ESEF Regulation, with ESMA's ESEF Reporting Manual, which",
           "sets out the rules on extension concepts and their anchoring.",
           "The taxonomy is the IFRS taxonomy with ESMA's additions."),
     paste("**Das Format.** Delegierte Verordnung (EU) 2019/815 der",
           "Kommission, die ESEF-Verordnung, mit dem ESEF Reporting Manual",
           "der ESMA, das die Regeln zu Erweiterungskonzepten und ihrer",
           "Verankerung festlegt. Die Taxonomie ist die IFRS-Taxonomie mit",
           "den Ergänzungen der ESMA.")),
  tr(paste("**The deadline.** Article 4 of Directive 2004/109/EC, the",
           "Transparency Directive, under which an issuer makes its annual",
           "financial report public at the latest four months after the end",
           "of each financial year."),
     paste("**Die Frist.** Artikel 4 der Richtlinie 2004/109/EG, der",
           "Transparenzrichtlinie, nach dem ein Emittent seinen",
           "Finanzbericht spätestens vier Monate nach Ende jedes",
           "Geschäftsjahres veröffentlicht.")),
  tr(paste("**The market.** ESMA's Financial Instruments Reference Data",
           "System (FIRDS), through the `firds` module of fincommons, for",
           "the shares admitted to trading in the Union and the issuer of",
           "each."),
     paste("**Der Markt.** Das Financial Instruments Reference Data System",
           "(FIRDS) der ESMA, über das Modul `firds` von fincommons, für die",
           "zum Handel in der Union zugelassenen Aktien und ihre",
           "Emittenten.")),
  tr(paste("**The pipeline.** The `esef` module of fincommons, which",
           "collects the indexes and the reports and reads them into the",
           "two Silver tables this report counts. The module's README",
           "describes the tables, and the factsheet template beside this",
           "one reads the same tables for a single issuer."),
     paste("**Die Pipeline.** Das Modul `esef` von fincommons, das die",
           "Verzeichnisse und Berichte einsammelt und in die beiden",
           "Silver-Tabellen liest, die dieser Bericht zählt. Die README des",
           "Moduls beschreibt die Tabellen, und die Factsheet-Vorlage",
           "daneben liest dieselben Tabellen für einen einzelnen",
           "Emittenten.")))

cat(paste(sources, collapse = "\n\n"))
```
